maria (eng-security): we received a DSAR from an EU user asking deletion of embeddings + backups. they attached ID proof.
jon (privacy): validating identity now. which S3 prefix and CMK? any replicas?
maria (eng-security): prefix s3://embeddings-eu/user-042/ encrypted with kms:alias/rdw-eu-vec. nightly snapshots replicate to us-west-2.
lee (eng-platform): note: replicas use different CMK ARNs. do not schedule CMK deletion. instead revoke grants and rotate data keys if needed.
sara (legal): confirm there is no legal hold. if cleared, legal approves erase once identity verified.
jon (privacy): verified. what is the safe erase flow (audit + forensics friendly)?
maria (eng-security): plan: 1) create ephemeral dsar-run role with scoped S3/KMS perms (TTL 1h). 2) mark snapshot metadata as "erasure_in_progress". 3) delete live prefix in eu. 4) call regional agent to delete replicas in us-west-2. 5) revoke KMS grants; rotate DEKs if necessary. 6) assemble audit bundle: object keys + sha256, replication status, KMS key ids, revoke logs, signed audit envelope. redact unrelated PII. upload to evidence vault and send receipt.
lee (eng-platform): RBAC: privacy team gets trigger-only role privacy.erase_trigger that issues workflow tokens; they cannot access S3/KMS directly. require two-person approval (privacy + eng-security).
ops-bot: Runbook invoked: runbook/dsar/erase v1 by maria
maria (eng-security): running deletes now. internal commands (redacted).
jon (privacy): ensure audit bundle includes workflow token id, TTL, and grant revocation traces.
maria (eng-security): will include. posting updates here.
ops-bot: Approval completed: 2-person check passed. job queued.
maria (eng-security): update: EU live objects deleted at 4623456845; replica delete queued for us-west-2.
lee (eng-platform): replica purge in progress; replication lag ~3m.
maria (eng-security): final: replicas removed, grants revoked, audit package uploaded (evidence-id: ev-4623456789). sending receipt to requester.
jon (privacy): received. closing ticket.
sara (legal): reviewed receipt; no retention exception. closing.
